#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Deterministic read-only SQL audit profiles for the universal Worker.

The request selects only an allow-listed profile. It never supplies SQL text.
All database access uses EDARSAHUB's canonical readonly_sql_connection.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BACKEND = ROOT / "backend"
if str(BACKEND) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND))

from core.sql_first.db import readonly_sql_connection

PROFILE = "gate1_connections_internationalization"
TARGET_NAMES = {
    "Sistema_Capacidades",
    "Sistema_TiposVariantes",
    "Sistema_Sync_Catalogo",
    "Sistema_VersionesSistemas",
    "Sistema_MapeoTablasVersion",
    "Sistema_MapeoColumnasVersion",
    "Servidores_Conexiones",
    "Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad",
}
KEYWORDS = (
    "empresa", "unidad", "timezone", "zona", "pais", "moneda",
    "divisa", "cambio", "idioma", "locale", "preferencia",
    "credencial", "secreto", "homolog", "layout", "evidencia",
    "ejecucion", "externo", "software", "version", "sync",
    "capacidad",
)


def rows(cur):
    cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description]
    return [dict(zip(cols, row)) for row in cur.fetchall()]


def select(cur, sql):
    normalized = " ".join(sql.strip().split()).upper()
    if not (normalized.startswith("SELECT " ) or normalized.startswith("WITH ")):
        raise RuntimeError("READ_ONLY_SQL_GUARD_REJECTED")
    cur.execute(sql)
    return rows(cur)


def id_list(values):
    clean = sorted({int(value) for value in values})
    return ",".join(str(value) for value in clean)


def run_gate1():
    out = {
        "schema": "edarsahub.sql-readonly-audit.v1",
        "profile": PROFILE,
        "generated_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "read_only": True,
        "ddl": False,
        "dml": False,
    }
    with readonly_sql_connection() as conn:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        out["database_identity"] = select(
            cur,
            "SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS database_user",
        )
        all_tables = select(
            cur,
            "SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS object_name, t.object_id, t.create_date, t.modify_date FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id ORDER BY s.name,t.name",
        )
        related = []
        exact = []
        for item in all_tables:
            name = str(item.get("object_name") or "")
            lower = name.lower()
            if name in TARGET_NAMES:
                exact.append(item)
            if name in TARGET_NAMES or any(keyword in lower for keyword in KEYWORDS):
                related.append(item)
        related = related[:500]
        out["target_objects"] = exact
        out["related_objects"] = related
        ids = id_list(item["object_id"] for item in related if item.get("object_id") is not None)
        if ids:
            out["columns"] = select(cur, f"SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS object_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE t.object_id IN ({ids}) ORDER BY s.name,t.name,c.column_id")
            out["indexes"] = select(cur, f"SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS object_name,i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,i.type_desc,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal,ic.is_included_column FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE t.object_id IN ({ids}) ORDER BY s.name,t.name,i.name,ic.key_ordinal,ic.index_column_id")
            out["foreign_keys"] = select(cur, f"SELECT sch1.name AS schema_name,t1.name AS table_name,fk.name AS fk_name,c1.name AS column_name,sch2.name AS referenced_schema,t2.name AS referenced_table,c2.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.tables t1 ON t1.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas sch1 ON sch1.schema_id=t1.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c1 ON c1.object_id=t1.object_id AND c1.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables t2 ON t2.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas sch2 ON sch2.schema_id=t2.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c2 ON c2.object_id=t2.object_id AND c2.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE t1.object_id IN ({ids}) OR t2.object_id IN ({ids}) ORDER BY sch1.name,t1.name,fk.name")
        else:
            out["columns"] = []
            out["indexes"] = []
            out["foreign_keys"] = []
    print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, default=str, separators=(",", ":")))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--profile", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.profile != PROFILE:
        raise SystemExit("UNSUPPORTED_READ_ONLY_AUDIT_PROFILE")
    run_gate1()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, ROOT / path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    assert spec.loader is not None
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def base_job():
    return {
        "schema": "edarsahub.worker-job.v2",
        "job_id": "readonly-gate-test",
        "target_repo": "rbalam/EDARSA_HUB",
        "target_branch": "Edarsahub_Desarrollo",
        "production_allowed": False,
        "objective": "test",
        "human_summary_language": "es",
        "mode": "READ_ONLY_SQL",
        "actions": [],
        "checks": [{"type": "sql_readonly_audit", "profile": "gate1_connections_internationalization"}],
    }


def test_bridge_accepts_fixed_readonly_profile():
    bridge = load("worker_bridge_readonly_test", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_bridge.py")
    assert bridge.validate(base_job()) == []


def test_bridge_rejects_arbitrary_profile():
    bridge = load("worker_bridge_readonly_profile_test", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_bridge.py")
    job = base_job()
    job["checks"][0]["profile"] = "arbitrary"
    assert any("INVALID_READ_ONLY_PROFILE" in error for error in bridge.validate(job))


def test_bridge_rejects_actions_in_readonly_mode():
    bridge = load("worker_bridge_readonly_actions_test", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_bridge.py")
    job = base_job()
    job["actions"] = [{"type": "write_file", "path": "x.txt", "content": "x"}]
    assert "READ_ONLY_ACTIONS_PROHIBITED" in bridge.validate(job)


def test_audit_script_uses_only_canonical_readonly_connection():
    text = (ROOT / "tools/mirror_sync/sql_readonly_audit.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "readonly_sql_connection" in text
    assert "parser.add_argument(\"--profile\", required=True)" in text
    assert "parser.add_argument(\"--sql\"" not in text
    upper = text.upper()
    assert "INSERT INTO" not in upper
    assert "UPDATE SET" not in upper
    assert "DELETE FROM" not in upper
    assert "DROP TABLE" not in upper
    assert "ALTER TABLE" not in upper


def test_publisher_preserves_readonly_evidence_status():
    publisher = load("worker_result_publisher_readonly_test", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_result_publisher.py")
    evidence = publisher.certification_evidence({"status": "READ_ONLY_COMPLETE", "percent_complete": 100})
    assert evidence["certification"] == "READ_ONLY_EVIDENCE"
    assert evidence["percent_complete"] == 100
